jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Unarmed Facility Patrol in Chicago, IL, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer at a commercial real estate location, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support a welcoming environment for tenants and visitors. You will conduct routine patrols, communicate professionally, and provide exceptional customer service while reflecting Allied Universal's agile, reliable, innovative, and people-first culture.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $17.84 / Hour

Job Schedule:
DayTimeMon10:00 PM - 06:00 AMTue10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSat10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM
What You'll Do:
  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, and/or contractors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at a commercial real estate location.
  • Respond to incidents, access concerns, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, escalating matters in accordance with site procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of building interiors, exterior grounds, parking areas, and perimeter locations to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity, maintain required logs and incident reports, and communicate observations to site management and/or Allied Universal leadership.
  • Assist with property-specific procedures, including responding to alarms, supporting evacuation activities, and providing directions or assistance to occupants and visitors.

Minimum Requirements:
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:
  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Job Summary

Per Mar Security Services Job Opportunity

Work with the best! Per Mar Security, an industry leader in providing integrated security solutions, is seeking hardworking, motivated people.

Established in 1953, Per Mar Security Services is the largest, family-owned, full-service security company in the Midwest with more than 2,600 team members, operating in 25 branch locations. The company provides full-service security solutions for homes and businesses, including security officer services, smart home automation, burglar and fire alarms, access control, security cameras, alarm monitoring, investigative services, and background checks.

Job Skills / Requirements

Per Mar Security Services is seeking Entry Level and Experienced Security Officers to join our expanding team! Are you looking to change careers? Need a foot in the door for a new start? Let us be your path to professional success! We are interested in you!

Pay & Schedule

  1. $17.50 an hour
  2. 1st Shift: 7:30AM -4PM
  3. Monday - Friday

Must Have:

  • Previous Experience in Security
  • Required Training is preferred
  • Security Guard License is preferred
  • Must submit or pass a background check
  • Great communication skills

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Stand guard at security officer post, directing visitors, issuing access badges, and providing escorts as necessary.
  • Log visitor data and other basic reports in the security computer system.
  • Conduct foot patrols in accordance with post orders.
  • Respond to alarms and emergencies as directed in post orders.
  • Look for and report potential safety hazards.
  • Wear and maintain appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as outlined for the position and follow all PPE policies and procedures.
  • Follow all client site-specific duties, as required and outlined in post-orders.
  • Work additional hours when necessary – fill open shifts, as needed.
  • Adhere to the highest standards of ethical business conduct and compliance by acting lawfully, ethically, honestly and professionally in the performance of their jobs at all times as well as be in compliance with company policy and procedures as it relates to their job function.
  • Assume responsibility for understanding and complying with Per Mar Security Services attendance expectations.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by interacting with the Per Mar Security Services internal/external customers (including, but not limited to current customers, prospective customers, clients, vendors, co-workers, supervisors and management) in a mutually respectful manner regardless of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation and all other protected classes.

What you'll need:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • State Security Officer License
  • Valid driver's license and a good driving record.
  • Technical training or college education in the related field (preferred)
  • Previous experience as a security officer (preferred)
  • Must possess the values important to Per Mar Security – Integrity, Communication, Excellent Service, and Accountability.
Education Requirements (All)

High School Diploma/GED

Certification Requirements (All)

Permanent Employee Registration Card 20 hour basic training

Additional Information / Benefits

Benefits: Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, 401K/403b Plan

This job reports to Ty McFadden

This is a Full and Part-Time position 1st Shift, School Hours, Weekends, Summers.

jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer Job at Unconquerable Security Solutions in Chicago
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Security Officer Duties & Requirements
The Security Officer is responsible for securing the premises, protecting personnel, and maintaining a safe environment by patrolling the property, monitoring surveillance equipment, inspecting buildings, equipment, and access points, and controlling entry onto the property.
Duties include responding to emergencies by sounding alarms and obtaining assistance, preventing loss or damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policies and procedures, and addressing trespassers when necessary.
The officer may also assist with traffic control by directing drivers and maintaining order in designated areas.
The Security Officer is expected to complete detailed reports by documenting observations, incidents, surveillance activity, witness statements, and required signatures.
Additional responsibilities include monitoring building systems and equipment controls, supporting preventive maintenance procedures, reporting equipment malfunctions, and assisting with improvements to security operations.
Candidates must be reliable, dependable, and able to conduct consistent patrols.
They must have a working understanding of mobile security patrol applications, communicate exceptionally well, and demonstrate a strong history of professionalism, accountability, and consistent work ethic.
Duties & Requirements
Must be able to patrol the property, monitor surveillance equipment, inspect buildings, equipment, and access points, and permit authorized entry.
Must respond appropriately to emergencies, sound alarms when necessary, and obtain assistance when needed.
Must prevent loss and damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policies and procedures, and addressing trespassers when appropriate.
Must assist with traffic control by directing drivers and maintaining order in designated areas.
